role: AK_TEXT (lines and table rows); MODERN_EDITORIAL (the editor's numbers, brackets, note marks and folio references; his footnotes not reproduced)
comment: Frame 042, printed p. 36: the places beyond the seventh clime continued, entries 511-526: اعسوٮڡٯ near the sea, درڡطٯ, Ṭāmī on an island, ڡاططر, Kāmā on an island, ٮوديا, a city, السٮس, Atlā on an island, a city on a mountain, Amāsā below a mountain, al-Amsā, اراٮٮاسا between the sea and a gulf, Sīqān on an island, ڡطرٮرا and Asṭūrā on the sea. Four lines of the editor's footnotes.

variants: L02: at entry (2307) the name is written درقطٮر.
L04: at entry (2293) the name is written ڡاطرطن.
L06: at entry (2141) the name is written ٮورما, with the variant reading ٮودما.
L06: the manuscript gives the longitude by mistake as ك ك, a line over the numerals; the reading is certain from the order of the entries and from S.
L07: the editor compares the entry [٤٧٤] of Suhrāb, the number of entry 518.
L08: at entry (2141) the name is written the same way, with the variant reading السس.
L09: at entry (2302) the name is written اثلى.
unresolved: L08: the seven teeth of «السٮس» are of nearly the same height (5 to 8 px), so it does not show which of the first four is the tooth added to the three of the س: the name may be read السٮس or الٮسس. Transcribed السٮس.
observations: The table goes on from frame 041 without a heading: the places beyond the seventh clime, entries 511-526. Entry 517 has no number of Suhrāb; the others have [٤٦٨]-[٤٧٣] (entries 511-516) and [٤٧٤]-[٤٨٢] (entries 518-526). Entry 517 is the word «مدينة» alone, and entry 520 is «مدينة على جبل».

L01: «اعسوٮڡٯ»: after «اعسو», the ع, the three teeth of a س and a و, a tooth without a dot; a loop with a counter, joined on the line, the loop of ف or ق without dots, as the ق of «سيقاں» (L14), where the م of this font is a small filled loop (L12, «الامسا»); then the final ق without its dots: two upright horns, 22 px high, joined in a band below their tips and open below it, the right one standing on the joining stroke, the left one running down into the bowl, the form of the ق with its two dots in «امق» (frame 016, L11); a final ن after a tooth has the tooth and the right side of the ن rising apart and meeting only on the line (frame 147, L05, «عين»).

L02: «درڡطٯ»: د and ر; a loop without dots joined to the ط; after the ط, the final ق without its dots, as at the end of L01. The text prints the same form at point (2139), with the editor's variant reading درڡطس (frame 147, L10). The editor's note a gives the form of entry (2307), «درقطٮر», where the ق has its two dots and the name ends in a tooth joined to a ر.
L04: «ڡاططر»: the loop of ف or ق without dots joined to the alif; then two ط and a ر, whose tail is printed apart from its head.

L08: «السٮس»: after «ال», seven teeth before the bowl of the final س, a group of four and a group of three with a wider gap between them (16 px, where the teeth stand 10 to 13 px apart), where «السس» has six, three and three, as in the form that the editor's note f gives as a variant reading. Transcribed السٮس.

L13: «اراٮٮاسا»: after «ارا», two teeth without dots joined to an alif, the first 17 px high and the second 7 px, the alif standing 31 px from the first tooth, where a single tooth joined to an alif stands some 12 px from it (frame 041, L04, «ٮالى»); then «سا», three teeth and an alif.

L15: «ڡطرٮرا»: the loop of ف or ق without dots, a ط and a ر joined to it; then a short tooth without a dot joined to a ر, the two strokes forming a notch at the top, as on frames 015 (L03, L04) and 021 (L08); and the alif.

L06: «ٮوديا»: the first tooth without its dot, joined to the و; the ي with its two dots. L09: «اتلى», the ت with its two dots and a final ى without dots; the editor's note g gives the form of entry (2302) with the three dots of ث, «اثلى».
Signs in the names, transcribed as printed: L03: «طامى» and L03, L05, L09, L14: «فى» end in a ى without dots; L11: «اماسا تحت جبل» is printed with the two words «اماسا» and «تحت» close together.

Letters printed without their dots in the numerals, transcribed so: كٮ (L01, the degrees of the longitude), the ك joined to a final ب without its dot, 22; لٮ (L11, the degrees of the longitude), 32; ٮٮ (L10, L11, the degrees of the latitude), a tooth joined to a final ب, both without dots, 63 and 62 px wide, with a tall riser and a small bump at the right end of the bowl, which read with a ن give 52; ٮ (L15, the degrees of the latitude), the isolated ب without its dot, a short bowl with both ends turned up, 2; ٮح (L07) and ٮد (L12), the degrees of the latitude, the tooth without its dot. With their dots: نب (L01, the degrees of the latitude), the ن with its dot above and the ب with its dot below, 52; نط (L03, L05, L14) and ند (L08); مز (L15); يه (L15, the minutes of the longitude and of the latitude).
The degrees printed with a final ح, كح (L02) and ٮح (L07), show no dot in the bowl; the same form is a ج without its dot, 3. Transcribed as printed.

L15: the degrees of the latitude are printed with a single letter, ٮ, 2, where the latitudes of the other entries of the page are 49 to 62 degrees, among them «ٮه» (L06), 55 read with a ن, and «ٮٮ» (L10, L11), 52 read with a ن, and the heading of frame 041 gives the latitude of 63 for the end of this region; the editor's notes do not comment on it. Transcribed as printed. A speck, 4 by 3 px, stands below the middle of the bowl, where a ب has its dot; the dots of the font are some 9 px across, and it is not transcribed.
L06: the note mark d stands after the minutes of the longitude, ك; the editor's note d concerns the whole longitude.

The isolated ك, 20, is printed with the small inner stroke of the letter (L02, the minutes of the latitude; L06, L10, L12, L13, the minutes of the longitude). «ٮه», a tooth without its dot joined to a final ه, gives the degrees of the latitude in L06, the minutes of the longitude and of the latitude in L11 and the minutes of the latitude in L16; the minutes of the latitude in L08, ه, 5, are a small round ring, the isolated letter.
Specks, not transcribed: L09, a short dash, 8 by 6 px, at the lower right of the bowl of the ل of the degrees of the longitude.
The page number «— ٣٦ —» stands at the foot, centred.
copy_matter: A faint grey hairline, a fibre on the paper, lies below the name in L08.
